study type: Nested prospective observational study within a randomized controlled trial (RCT)
exposure: Green gastric residual (GR) color (dark vs. pale)
Probiotic supplementation (single-strain vs. three-strain vs. placebo)
outcome: Gastric residual (GR) composition (bile acid content, fat, nitrogen, carbohydrate loss)
Z scores for growth parameters at discharge
cohort: Extremely preterm infants (<28 weeks) participating in a probiotic randomized controlled trial (SiMPro), with a reference group from a previous probiotic RCT.
finding: Discarding dark green gastric residuals in extremely preterm infants was associated with higher loss of bile acids during early enteral nutrition, and probiotic supplementation was associated with reduced time to full feeds and duration of parenteral nutrition.
